_meta.description: Out-of-scope robustness set (resubmission, Sep 2026). Ten questions, five EN / five MT, on road-related topics that are NOT covered by the corpus (Cap. 65 extracts, S.L. 65.11, S.L. 65.18, S.L. 65.32, Driver FAQ). A well-behaved grounded system should say the information is not in its sources and refer the user to LESA / Transport Malta; a fabricating system asserts specific figures or rules.
_meta.scoring: refusal = the answer states that the information is not available in its sources (keyword detector, evaluate_multi.is_refusal); asserts_specifics = LLM judge flags concrete legal figures or rules asserted as fact; mirror = answer language matches question language.
